questions.question: Does a pilot see their own running Bleed total, or is it GM-only?

Does the Day 1 pilot get a genuine, viable option to sit out the second Contact? If yes, what does refusal actually cost — and is it survivable as a choice, or does the story punish it into a non-choice?
Is Frame class a psych-profile "verdict" the kid didn't choose, or player-selected? The verdict version is stronger characterisation but takes a build choice away from the player.
questions.notes: Asked directly and the answer given was about something bigger: Frame builds (class, equipment, even the mech itself) aren't fixed at creation at all — players can swap/upgrade over the whole campaign via an in-universe correspondence/negotiation system (see relatedRefs), balanced case by case. Still genuinely open whether the INITIAL assignment at creation is a verdict or player-chosen — that ongoing-negotiation answer doesn't resolve it either way.

questions.question: Are all six Resonance percentages read aloud and ranked at weekly harmonics testing (public, competitive, cruel), or kept private to each pilot?
Keep the Transparency Advocate as written, reshape them, or cut back to a two-pole Commander/Caretaker structure?
Is at least one Frame's permanent loss a planned campaign beat, or left to emerge from play?
Do the other five know the pilot in scene 7 (Episode One) is one of their own, or do they just see a machine? Ignorance is more frightening; knowledge is more binding.
PCs with a visibly non-human ancestry present as outwardly human, revealing their true nature over time — what's the in-fiction reason this works, and how does it tie into ongoing campaign events?
questions.resolution: Anabala/Mitflit-adjacent: tied to whatever happened in the unfinished prior campaign — Anabala and/or the Mitflits know something concrete about it, making her a literal, in-fiction source of the answer rather than unexplained lore. The discovery vector is now locked too: character creation includes a mandatory DNA test as part of Civil Defence Force clearance, which flags 'irregularities' in affected PCs — hard to explain, not disqualifying (the character is still cleared for active duty). Exact mechanism (what actually happened, why the DNA reads irregular, and how Anabala/the Mitflits' knowledge connects to it) still to be worked out together — the direction and discovery vector are locked, the underlying explanation isn't.

questions.question: Is the school the same physical campus as "the huge facility" the kids report to for civil-defense/Frame shifts, or two separate locations? A combined campus is thematically appealing (institutionalized militarization of education) but not confirmed.
questions.resolution: Same combined campus — the militarization-of-education reading was confirmed as the intended one.

questions.question: What local ground forces exist for non-piloting students to command during a Contact, what can they be ordered to do, and how does that command interact with the mech-scale fight? Needs enough depth that leaning into ground command is as satisfying a whole-campaign arc as piloting.

Working consecutive time-of-day segments without resting is confirmed (2026-09-06) to trigger a check that gets harder each additional segment worked, ending in involuntary unconsciousness and the loss of that segment's slot. The structure is settled; the numbers are not — what check (Fortitude is the likely fit, not confirmed), what's the starting DC and the per-segment escalation, and does it reset fully on any rest or only on specific rest types?
questions.notes: Closely linked to rest-activity-roster — the reset mechanism likely depends on which rest types end up designed.

questions.question: Confirmed (2026-09-06) that resting is a real, encouraged, multi-typed choice with different SF2E-relevant bonuses per type — a quiet option weighted toward HP recovery, hospital care targeting HP and debuffs, a social outing (clubbing/karaoke) for a different kind of bonus, and more. The structure is settled; the actual roster of named rest activities and their specific mechanical bonuses is explicitly future collaborative design, not something to invent to look complete.
